title: The Ghost Mismatch
prompt:
**Scenario.** Your stress harness found one mismatch, but the input was regenerated with a new random seed and now nothing fails. First move?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Move on — it was a fluke

**B)** Fix the seed: reproduce first, shrink second. An unreproducible failure is unfixable; re-seed with a fixed value and re-run the exact sequence

**C)** Increase the input size in the generator

**D)** Delete the brute force to speed up the loop

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Reproducibility is the harness's core contract: seed everything, log the seed with every mismatch. Only a reproducible failure can be shrunk into a counterexample.
